title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide to building good habits, breaking bad ones, and making small changes that produce remarkable results.

title: Deep Work
author: Cal Newport
description: Explains how focused work helps people produce valuable results and improve concentration in a distracted world.

title: The Psychology of Money
author: Morgan Housel
description: Explores how behaviour, emotions, and personal experiences shape the way people think about money and investing.

title: The Lean Startup
author: Eric Ries
description: Introduces a practical approach to building businesses through experimentation, customer feedback, and continuous improvement.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: Presents principles and examples for writing readable, maintainable, and reliable software.

title: Python Crash Course
author: Eric Matthes
description: A hands-on introduction to Python programming covering fundamentals and practical projects.

title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
author: Stuart Russell and Peter Norvig
description: A comprehensive introduction to artificial intelligence concepts, methods, search, learning, and intelligent agents.

title: Hands-On Machine Learning
author: Aurélien Géron
description: A practical guide to machine learning with Python, covering models, neural networks, and real-world workflows.

title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
author: Stephen R. Covey
description: A principle-centred approach to personal and professional effectiveness, responsibility, and relationships.

title: Start With Why
author: Simon Sinek
description: Explains how leaders and organisations inspire action by communicating their purpose.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
description: Explores two systems of thought and how judgement, bias, and decision-making shape human behaviour.

title: The Intelligent Investor
author: Benjamin Graham
description: A classic introduction to value investing, risk management, and long-term financial thinking.

title: The Design of Everyday Things
author: Don Norman
description: Explains human-centred design and how products can be made easier and more intuitive to use.

title: Don't Make Me Think
author: Steve Krug
description: A practical guide to web usability, helping designers create clear and easy-to-navigate digital experiences.

title: Mindset
author: Carol S. Dweck
description: Examines fixed and growth mindsets and how beliefs about ability influence learning and achievement.

title: The Personal MBA
author: Josh Kaufman
description: Introduces essential business concepts including value creation, marketing, sales, finance, and systems.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer
author: David Thomas and Andrew Hunt
description: Offers practical techniques and habits for becoming a more effective and adaptable software developer.

title: Zero to One
author: Peter Thiel and Blake Masters
description: Discusses innovation, entrepreneurship, and building businesses that create something genuinely new.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A philosophical novel about following dreams, discovering purpose, and learning from life's journey.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: Explores the history of humankind and the forces that shaped societies, culture, and civilisation.
